risks.quote: AI generated content may not be accurate (even where it includes references), the outputs are predictions, they are not facts, and the content may be based on biased or stereotypical perspectives.

The output may draw on copyright information as generative AI operates by scraping information from the internet without checking the owners’ permission.

responsibilities.quote: Any use of artificial intelligence must align with the principles of academic integrity as outlined by the International Centre for Academic Integrity.
Use generative AI that identifies where information is sourced from so that you can check that it has used a real source, them make sure that you do check the source
If it is a requirement of your course, and you have concerns about using AI, you should raise this with your course leader clearly explaining your concerns.
however there is no requirement for a course or programme to utilise generative AI.
HW will keep under review developments on generative AI detection tools.
